senses.gloss:
mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं)
Who or what drinks.
f. (-या)
A little girl, female infant.
E.
घे to drink, affix श.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Having, possessing, or who has or possesses.
E.
धा to have, ण aff.

m. (-य्यः)
A Purohita or family priest.
f. (-य्या)
A prayer for exciting fire, upon the addition of fuel.
E.
irregularly derived from धी to contain, with ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-याः-याः-यः)
An upholder.
E.
धा to have, &c. असुन् Uṇādi affix; also with a final vowel added, धायस.
